1. **Written quote and vendor comparison.** Request an all-in first-year six-staff quote for a short pilot, including setup, migration, training, support, modules/add-ons, export/storage fees, renewal terms, and taxes. 2. **Scheduling and changing service.** Use two unrelated synthetic cases. Overlap room, vehicle, and officiant/provider assignments separately; include tentative versus confirmed states. For a Nextcloud path, install the candidate backend, define a room, observe discovery delay, then book overlapping services and inspect overrides/recovery. Change one service after relatives arrive from another time zone; inspect local/remote time display, time zone, notification, owner, old/new state, and recoverability. Simulate simultaneous edits. Record what blocks, warns, permits, or escalates; color alone is not conflict control.
3. **Least privilege and disclosure surfaces.** Define the six actual staff roles and a role-by-field/action matrix. Populate two unrelated synthetic families with contacts, service preferences, faith/cultural requests, payment arrangements, private notes, event and task comments. Test an admin and role changes as well as staff. Inspect direct record links, lists/search, calendar popovers, personal-calendar connections/subscriptions, print, mobile/web, notifications, exports, and any API route offered. Record both allowed reads and attempted unauthorized reads; verify event-private flags and restricted views separately from staff roles.
4. **Family policy and permissions.** Keep family invitations off unless the owner elects to test them. In a synthetic case, demonstrate Viewer/Contributor/Editor or equivalent; inspect default role, exact fields/actions, event viewing versus staff-schedule editing, invitation, authentication, revocation, notification, audit, and recovery. Test a family-submitted correction, staff verification, and publication as separate steps. Do not turn a proposed correction-request workflow into a claimed product feature.
5. **Keyboard and translation.** Ask the keyboard-primary employee to find a service, change its time, resolve a resource warning, assign/complete a handoff, recover from an error, and export a record without a pointer. Record focus, labels, traps, and blocked steps. Have human speakers review sample instructions and schedule-change notices in the actual selected family languages, including culturally sensitive terms. These are product/workflow trials, not a consequence of an accessibility statement.
6. **Outage and reconciliation.** Simulate external internet failure while local network/power continue, then a separate LAN/power failure. For each role, record what can be seen or changed, what queues, how conflicts surface, how off-site family members are affected, and how edits reconcile. If testing the optional pre-storm snapshot, agree scope, 48-hour coverage, access, expiry/disposal, and a single numbered paper log/coordinator. Do not assume CalDAV client sync proves browser offline editing.
7. **Independent export/restore.** Before entering real data, choose the minimum independently retainable package.
